## Protect selected

Ada puts the register aside. "We can work together, but you will answer these questions." Neri nods and pulls up another chair. They begin sorting the leads as partners, warily rebuilding trust.

## Challenge selected

Ada leaves the ledger where Neri can see it. "I will investigate without you until the record is clear." Neri does not follow. The distance between them settles into something harder than anger.
